notes.title: 2nd major contents update!
notes.notes:
■ Chapter 4 released.
- 4 additional stages.

■ We updated the Infinity Arena!
- In Infinity Arena, enemies appear randomly and become stronger at each stage.
- If you win the higher level, the higher quality reward.
- Up to 7th place will be registered on the ranking board depending on the results of Infinity Arena's game.
- Rankings are reset every Monday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001257/96835d173ad5e45a2a51086705735c1aa64d1dda.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes October 28, 2021
notes.notes:
Chapter 1 Enemy Balance Patch
- We have lowered the attack power and HP of the enemies in Chapter 1.
- All stages (1~9) and all difficulties (1~3) in Chapter 1 are affected by the difficulty adjustment.

notes.title: First major content update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001257/d049359ecb9893c1002d3485a19cc900e197bace.png[/img]

New Chapter 3 release.
- 9 additional stages. Each stage difficulty level 1-3
- 25 new reward characters have been added as rewards that can be obtained when completing the stages of Chapter 3.

notes.title: We will notify you of updates.
notes.notes:
Changed BGM: Replaced with music more suitable for the game.
Changed font: Changed to the font provided by the game rather than the system font when running on Windows in a language other than Korean or English.
